title: How I Almost Ruined MrBeast Squid Game
summary: William Osman describes helping build parts of the MrBeast Squid Game event, including hacking together hundreds of wifi-controlled blood packs in about three weeks. He covers the chaos and near-failures along the way.
why: Makers recommend it as a behind-the-scenes look at crunch-time hardware engineering for a big YouTube production.

quote.text: the making off video of his squid game blood packs is really interesting from a maker perspective
